notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
Thank a lots for playing Abduction Bit! ː16bitHeartː

Today we have released a new updated, we have fixed some glitches and improved the "Dynamic Scanlines" mode!

https://i.ibb.co/WfjvmWX/Screen-abduction.png

Thank you very much for your feedback!
by
SEEP

notes.title: New update: remap keyboard and joypad input select
notes.content:
Hi guys!
First, thank you for your support and your feedback! :16bitHeart:

:8bitfire: We have released a new update, here the features: :8bitfire:

- Now you can remap the keyboard keys.
- Now you can select the port/input of your controllers.
- Added new seep logo
- fixed some glitches and bugs.

Thank you to playing Abduction Bit, we want improve our work to make a good experiece for all users! Thanks! :8bitgrey:

notes.title: FREE DLC 16 Bit Hard Pack OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys! ː8bitgreyː

First: very, very thanks for your feedbacks, reviews, screenshots and videos; we are very happy see many people have enjoyed playing with Abduction Bit! 

We have released our second FREE DLC: 16 Bit Hard Pack.
Features:
- 20 new levels!
- A new achievement!
- Fix some glitches.

Thank you for the support, for any feedback check the HUB of Abduction Bit here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/550810
We will continue to working on new level packs!

 Have a great week end, aliens! ː8bitgreyː ː16bitHeartː
